title: Ahsoka Season 2 Trailer Star Wars D23
report:
Disney just dropped some Ahsoka news at their D23 expo.

According to The Hollywood Reporter, a trailer was shown at D23 in Anaheim, giving us our first look at the upcoming second season of the Star Wars series. Along with that came a new poster and a first-look photo (above). 

The series stars Rosario Dawson as Ahsoka Tano and follows her journey across the galaxy.

Season 2 continues after a long wait – the last episode aired in October 2023 – and will drop on Disney+ early next year.
